entries.problem: Locations painted selection actions in a page-owned sticky footer instead of the DataTable header action plane.
entries.exitCriteria: The selected-row count, verbs, overflow and Clear control are all painted by DataTable's header plane.

entries.problem: SelectionAction, RecordActionVerb and TableStatusSelectionAction describe overlapping verbs and allow different pages to paint different action chrome.
entries.exitCriteria: A page declares action facts once; the table engine resolves selection and RecordActionStrip paints the same partition on every page.

entries.problem: DataTable bulkBar accepts arbitrary ReactNode content, so a port can silently introduce different selection chrome.
entries.exitCriteria: DataTable accepts a typed contextual-action declaration and owns the RecordActionStrip header face; no page passes hand-painted bulk chrome.

entries.problem: InspectorFloorDelete and several feature controls keep independent armed/delete timers and labels.
entries.exitCriteria: Every two-press destructive control consumes one shared armed state machine; face-specific components only choose icon/text layout.

entries.problem: LocationDeletionManager owns orchestration, hierarchy selectors, exact-target rows and the action floor in one oversized file.
entries.exitCriteria: The manager is the controller; scope controls and exact-target preview are leaf components with no duplicate mutation logic.

entries.problem: RailActionRegion separately partitions and paints danger actions instead of consuming the shared action-strip partition.
entries.exitCriteria: The rail adapts its action facts into the shared renderer and owns no separate danger-button ordering or paint.

entries.problem: Zero-count provisional SKU rows are excluded from Out of stock in both the client facet resolver and the uncapped database count, so the chip is disabled while an out-of-stock row is visible.
entries.exitCriteria: A zero-count provisional row belongs to both Out of stock and On hold; its uncapped chip counts and row filter agree, while positive on-hold stock remains In stock plus On hold.

entries.problem: A second table engine (compound row model + cells) shipped beside the card list and the canonical DataTable; its last live mounts were the /unbox lines grid (receiving-grid) and the TaskTable select face. Retired 2026-10-03: /unbox Queue · Recent are the receive.queue carton card list (UnboxCartonCards over ReceivingCartonCard), TaskTable selects through GridRowCheckbox. materialize-tracks.ts stays — it is the keep-sheet column materializer (bins, ready, CSV staging, tech-all). Plan: docs/refactors/DELETE-LIST.md §3.
entries.exitCriteria: /unbox lines and TaskTable render without compound modules (TaskTable's select face is GridRowCheckbox); src/components/tables/compound and src/components/station/receiving-grid are deleted, their Compound* / compound-row-chrome pins leave src/design-system/pinned.json, and knip reports no orphan they left. A list that needs a job again returns as a TriageViewDecl card view, never a compound grid.

entries.problem: Twenty-nine per-domain compound grid folders, their pages and 88 field-catalog files rendered only behind routes the proxy already redirected. Deleted 2026-10-03; the redirects stay as URL compatibility.
entries.exitCriteria: No page, grid hook or field family exists behind a parked redirect; a job that needs a list again returns as a TriageViewDecl card view (mobile V2 first), never a compound grid.

entries.problem: Card adapters can ignore their view declaration: Stock declares a state status but paints none, passes quickLook={null} so Space shows nothing, and hides the rack total; imports, incoming pipeline and the FNSKU print desk declare state and paint none.
entries.exitCriteria: TriageViewDecl declares every anatomy slot (identity, channel, person, status, facts, quickLook, with explicit 'none'); a card whose status kind or quick look disagrees with its view fails tsc or triage-views.test.ts.

entries.problem: The private scanlog:{staffId} channel, /api/scan/history and PhoneHistoryPopover duplicated the personal durable history that /stations/live (My history) owns.
entries.exitCriteria: The quick-access history door opens My history; publishScanLog, getScanLogChannelName and the scanlog grant are gone; resolver-only scans still paint as Identified.

entries.problem: Wave 1. Purchase orders (including the external Goodwill script) reach CycleForge by way of Zoho Inventory: PO mirror, incoming-PO sync, receive backfill/push, find-po, webhooks and the useZohoSync prefill. zoho-receiving-sync inserts receiving_line directly, bypassing ingestInboundOrder. Reorder suggestions are already native (replenishment.ts) and only carry an exportToZoho option.
entries.exitCriteria: Goodwill and every other PO source post InboundOrderDraft through the authenticated machine import API; no inbound_order row with source_type 'zoho' is created for 14 days; replenishment has no exportToZoho path; the three PO crons leave vercel.json and CRON_JOBS; Zoho-only PO tables drop in an owner-approved migration.

entries.problem: Channel orders were pushed into Zoho as sales orders (OrderSyncService, order_ingest_queue drain) and shipments/invoices pushed back (fulfillment-sync). Prod evidence 2026-10-03: 38,814 drain runs claimed 0 rows; sales_orders and order_ingest_queue were empty; every fulfillment-sync run was a dry run.
entries.exitCriteria: Channel orders land only through createOrder; no code pushes sales orders, packages, shipments or invoices to Zoho; the empty sales_orders, packages, invoices and order_ingest_queue tables drop in an owner-approved migration.

entries.problem: Wave 2. Zoho items, item images and warehouse stock are mirrored and pushed (InventorySyncService, itemRepository, inventory zoho-adapter) although sku_catalog and bin_contents are the stated sources of truth.
entries.exitCriteria: Titles, photos and stock read only sku_catalog, native photos and bin_contents; catalog_external_ids carries no zoho rows that any reader needs; items, zoho_item_images, item_location_stock and item_stock_cache drop in an owner-approved migration.

entries.problem: Wave 3. The Zoho Inventory client, OAuth, token refresh and integration connector remain only to serve the three Zoho mirrors above.
entries.exitCriteria: zoho-purchase-order-middleman, zoho-sales-order-mirror and zoho-item-stock-mirror are retired; no source imports @/lib/zoho; integrations.zoho permission and Zoho-only columns are removed.

entries.problem: Wave 1. Two routes INSERT INTO orders directly beside the canonical createOrder writer.
entries.exitCriteria: orders has one writer module; a label bought outside CycleForge is identified through the phone manual outbound sheet, which calls createOrder plus registerDraftTracking.

entries.problem: Wave 2. Inbound urgency is spread over receiving_carton.is_priority, priority_tier, receiving_triage.priority_lane and a hardcoded platform rank; inbound_order.priority_tier is never copied to the carton at arrival, and staging shelves are operator-chosen.
entries.exitCriteria: One urgency band is computed server-side from the tenant's per-platform default, the inbound order's priority and outbound demand; arrival returns the assigned slot; is_priority and priority_lane have no readers.

entries.problem: Wave 3. Phone picking has two step machines: /m/pick?order= drives desk REST endpoints with no tote and no bin_contents decrement; /m/pick/[orderId] drives the WMS pick.confirm command with tote binding and clientEventId replay.
entries.exitCriteria: Owner amends SURFACE_LAW §8; Start picking walks through pick.confirm with a tote; picking decrements the source location; desk REST picking routes have no phone caller.

entries.problem: Wave 3. Pack resolution accepts outbound tracking, bins and unit serials besides the tote, so the outbound tracking number is scanned at Pick, Pack and Scan out. The phone pack-queue resolver (src/lib/packing/pack-scan.ts) was deleted with the /m/pack queue on 2026-10-03; the desk pack scan ladder remains.
entries.exitCriteria: Pack is entered only by tote; outbound tracking is owned only by Scan out; any other scan redirects to the job that owns it.

entries.problem: Wave 4. Each desktop station classifies scans its own way (arrival command routing, unbox classifier, testing resolver, PackScanColumn ladder, scan-out commit predicate) beside the canonical routeScan/classifyInput/dispatch table.
entries.exitCriteria: Retired with legacy-desktop-scan-stations; every scan resolves through the identification kernel by identifier class and entity state.

entries.problem: Wave 4. Desktop Arrival, Unbox, Quality Control, Picker, Packing and Scan out execute the same jobs the phone owns, with their own step machines, scan sinks, phone bridges and right-rail displays.
entries.exitCriteria: Gates 31-36 of docs/handoff/GOAL-phone-driven-scan-stations-v2-2026-10-01.md pass; desktop-only edit verbs live on canonical record pages.

entries.problem: Phone quantity entry had three faces: the desk-dense StockQtySlider (32 px steppers + slider tunnel) on the stock sheet, LocationQtyStrip, and a one-off FnskuCopiesStepper.
entries.exitCriteria: Absolute counts, splits and label copies on /m use TouchQtyStepper; scan-backed ± bursts use LocationQtyStrip; StockQtySlider stays desk-only.

entries.problem: Location (bin) and bay (rack) label printing ran two controller hooks, two Mobile/Desktop builder pairs mounted as lg:hidden + hidden lg:block dual trees, and byte-identical RoomPicker / StepPills / ZoneLetterTile copies; the phone had no route for the verb and printed only in its own browser. Retired 2026-10-03: one LocationLabelBuilder at /m/labels, mounted by the desk in MobileFirstFrame.
entries.exitCriteria: One LocationLabelBuilder step machine (variant bin | rack) over one controller hook, mounted at /m/labels and inside a phone-width MobileFirstFrame on /inventory/locations?tab=labels|bays; no lg:hidden / hidden lg:block under src/components/barcode; one RoomPicker, StepPills and ZoneLetterTile.

entries.problem: Phones ran two sheet systems: Radix ui/sheet for V2 record sheets (fixed h-[82–92dvh] heights) and the house BottomSheet (43 consumers, no focus trap). Heights, dismissal and stacking differed by which one a page imported. Retired 2026-10-03 (owner ruling: Radix is THE sheet): all 43 consumers moved to @/components/ui/sheet (content-sized SheetContent side="bottom", size="full", SheetBody); ConfirmSheet lives at src/components/ui/ConfirmSheet.tsx.
entries.exitCriteria: One phone sheet primitive: content-sized, a DetailDock placement="sheet" floor, focus trap, and no fixed dvh heights under src/components/mobile.

entries.problem: Owner 2026-10-03: no phone record text is truncated; records are grouped cards (identity top-left, date top-right, full title, count bottom-left, money bottom-right) that drill in. 69 mobile files still truncate or clamp record text and sit in eslint.config.mjs MOBILE_RECORD_TRUNCATION_FROZEN_DEBT. DetailSummaryCard (pinned 'one full-width title (truncate)') and LocationBadge (truncates bin paths) are design-system roots outside the lint scope that still truncate.
entries.exitCriteria: MOBILE_RECORD_TRUNCATION_FROZEN_DEBT is empty and the cf-mobile/no-truncated-record-text rule has no ignores beyond the three top-bar/switcher chrome files; DetailSummaryCard and LocationBadge wrap.

entries.problem: Room-agnostic racks handoff (2026-10-03) §4/§7: the room is derived by walking parent_id to the nearest ROOM, never copied. Rack/shelf/position rows leave locations.room NULL and adopted bay rows have it cleared, so any reader of the legacy room text shows no room (or groups wrongly) for a movable rack's shelves. Migrated to derived-room.ts: /api/locations?room= picker, /api/locations/[barcode] previous/next walk + room, pair-candidates room, cycle-count room scope + line order, stock ledger room filter/grouping/facets, bins overview room filter/search/order, bin-utilization report room. Still reading the text column (display or room admin only, no rack shelf hidden): getActiveLocations order + roomStructure grid (aisle-bay only), getBinContentsAtBarcode/getBinLocationsBySku/getLowStockBins, room admin by text (setRoomZoneLetter/renameRoom/reorderRooms/softDeleteRoom), legacy writers createLocation/bulkCreateBinRange/registerPrintedLocations; receiving detail/stage/recent-staged/returns-test-bin/staging-map displays; stock-alerts; sku-stock bins; listSkuStockedAt; assistant wms-tools; orders-list storage/home room; provisional-sku; pack-placement; printSpecialBinLabel; location-crud/location-deletion room text scope; mv_bin_utilization.room snapshot. Legacy room-coded builders still compose codes from the room zone letter: expand-print-run.ts and the bin-label/rack printers.
entries.exitCriteria: Every location read derives its room from parent_id: no server reader selects, filters, groups or orders by locations.room (only derived-room.ts reads a ROOM row's own key), the room-coded builders compose no code from a room letter, and npm run verify:derived-room stays green until the column is dropped.
